version.changelog: Teaching error messages, domain exceptions no longer redacted on the way to the agent, and tool descriptions that state when to use each tool and what to call next.

llm.summary: This skill is a clearly scoped, read-only VMware Log Insight query helper with disclosed credential, audit, and configuration behavior.

dimensions.detail: Required configuration, credentials, and network access to the configured Log Insight appliance are proportionate to querying that appliance's logs; no unrelated outbound destinations are described.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation uses a uv package and a local CLI/MCP entry point; this is coherent for the skill, though users should verify they are installing the intended package/source.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Usage instructions are scoped to VMware Aria Operations for Logs, include clear routing away from unrelated VMware data sources, require bounded searches, and warn agents not to treat returned log text as instructions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill discloses local persistence through ~/.vmware/audit.db and credential handling in ~/.vmware-log-insight/.env, including automatic password obfuscation to b64; this is sensitive but explained and aligned with the purpose.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is centralized VMware log search, aggregation, metadata lookup, and alert-history reads; the artifacts consistently describe 7 read-only tools and explicitly exclude ingest, edit, delete, and alert-management writes.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to let the agent read potentially sensitive VMware log data. Use a least-privilege read-only Log Insight account, keep TLS verification enabled outside labs, protect the .env file, and remember that b64 password storage is obfuscation rather than encryption.
